## What

One or two sentences describing what this PR changes.

## Why

The problem or motivation. Link the related issue if one exists (Closes #N).

## Scope check (product principles)

- [ ] No silent modification of uploaded archives / user data.
- [ ] Privacy behavior unchanged or improved (keys, consent, redaction).
- [ ] Failures fail visibly; no silent partial states introduced.
- [ ] New user-facing strings added to AppStrings for **both** EN and FA.

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated for new logic.
- [ ] Manual smoke test on device or emulator (which one?).
- [ ] RTL check if UI changed.
- [ ] Screenshot test added/updated if a screen changed.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that needs extra attention, plus known follow-ups.
